method: Native front demo samples at 0, 8, 12, 17, 23, 25.6, 26.6 and 32.9 s, plus frozen-source trace replay.
demo: Both hands pick up the flexible strip, lay it on the form, and the right hand smooths while the left retains the dry corner. The left then peels back, moves the strip clear and releases it.
dream: The complete 1,000-action Dream run leaves the strip on the table without applying it. Rear views at 0, 15, 30 and 50 seconds and the initial top policy image were checked.
limitations: Coarse flexible sheet and breakable adhesion; no individual hairs, skin mechanics or treatment-safety claim. The application rubric permits up to 30% not simultaneously smoothed and bonded.
setup: The setup image combines the initial front judging view with the initial top policy camera, enlarged for layout visibility. This makes the strip visible without moving the initial objects.
